domain_reviews.coverage_statement: Reviewed the county planning jurisdiction page and discoverable Wooster zoning records through September 9, 2026; the county notes that most unincorporated territory has no county zoning.
domain_reviews.finding: Wooster's code defines data centers and recent zoning tables address the use, but no candidate-specific facility, application, or developer approach was identified.
domain_reviews.label: County and municipal planning, zoning, and land-use records
limitations: Wayne County has multiple municipal and township jurisdictions without a unified, full-text historical application index.
A zoning definition or permitted-use table is not evidence that a project was proposed.
queries: Wayne County Ohio data center planning application
repositories: City of Wooster zoning-code and council-agenda archive

domain_reviews.coverage_statement: Reviewed WEDC's current and recently completed project inventory, site-selection materials, and the 2024 regional CEDS project summary.
domain_reviews.finding: The reviewed inventories describe manufacturing, food-processing, logistics, agribusiness, and site-readiness projects but identify no qualifying data-center project.
domain_reviews.label: Economic-development agreements, incentives, bonds, and tax abatements
limitations: The public project lists are curated rather than a complete historical incentive ledger.
Confidential or code-named prospects may not appear until a later public action.
queries: Wayne County Economic Development Council data center
Wayne County Ohio major projects data center
Wooster Orrville Rittman data center incentive
repositories: Wayne Economic Development Council current-project inventory
Northeast Ohio Four County Regional Planning and Development Organization CEDS

sources.publisher: Northeast Ohio Four County Regional Planning and Development Organization
sources.title: 2024 Comprehensive Economic Development Strategy

domain_reviews.coverage_statement: Reviewed a county-specific index derived from public generation and interconnection data and discoverable Orrville municipal-utility records through September 9, 2026.
domain_reviews.finding: The reviewed county energy index lists generation, solar, and battery records but no named data-center load or project; no qualifying facility was found in the municipal-utility material reviewed.
domain_reviews.label: Utility, grid-interconnection, transmission, water, and wastewater records
limitations: Generation and interconnection queues do not comprehensively expose retail load-service requests.
FirstEnergy, AEP, and municipal-utility confidential customer inquiries cannot be ruled out from public sources.
queries: Wayne County Ohio large load data center
Wayne County PJM data center interconnection
repositories: Public EIA, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, and PJM-derived Wayne County energy-project index
City of Orrville utilities and legislation archive

sources.title: Wayne County, Ohio Energy Projects and Interconnection Queue

domain_reviews.coverage_statement: Reviewed the searchable state environmental-document portal and discoverable Wayne County state project-submission records through September 9, 2026.
domain_reviews.finding: No county-specific data-center environmental or cultural-resource review was identified in the records surfaced by the completed queries.
domain_reviews.label: Air, water, environmental, and generator permitting records
limitations: The Ohio EPA portal is an entity- and program-oriented document library and does not provide a single reproducible export proving all historical Wayne County records were searched.
A project using closed-loop cooling or ordinary building permits may generate limited environmental records.
queries: Wayne County data center Ohio EPA
repositories: Ohio Historic Preservation Office project-submission lists

domain_reviews.coverage_statement: Reviewed the county parcel-search entry point and WEDC's promoted industrial-site materials, including the Wooster and Rittman sites.
domain_reviews.finding: No data-center owner, option, acquisition, or named site-control event was identified in the reviewed public materials.
domain_reviews.label: Deeds, options, site-control records, and named development parcels
limitations: Parcel systems require a known owner, address, or parcel and cannot prove the absence of undisclosed options or affiliates.
The site-selection inventory markets available land and is not a complete historical transaction register.
queries: Wayne County Ohio data center property acquisition
repositories: Wayne Economic Development Council site-selection inventory

domain_reviews.coverage_statement: Reviewed major public facility directories and discoverable trade reporting through September 9, 2026, disambiguating results for Wayne County, Michigan, Pennsylvania, and New York.
domain_reviews.finding: No facility listing or trade report for a qualifying Wayne County, Ohio data center was identified.
domain_reviews.label: Company announcements and data-center trade reporting
limitations: Commercial directories are voluntary and incomplete, especially for enterprise and government facilities.
Searches repeatedly returned same-name counties in other states, requiring manual geographic exclusion.
repositories: Data Center Map Ohio market directory

domain_reviews.coverage_statement: Reviewed indexed local-news results, the public library's historical newspaper portal, and WEDC's current resource library through September 9, 2026.
domain_reviews.finding: No qualifying local project announcement, controversy, milestone, or public-hearing record was identified in the accessible results.
domain_reviews.label: Local news, public meetings, petitions, litigation, and organized opposition
limitations: The Daily Record blocks automated page access and its complete 1999-present archive requires a local library-card session.
The public preservation portal has uneven title coverage after 1963 and therefore cannot certify modern absence.
queries: Wayne County Ohio data center proposal
repositories: Wayne County Public Library newspaper archive
Wayne Economic Development Council news and resource library

sources.title: Digital Archive of Wayne County Public Library
